requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/clamp.js` and your own tests in `tests/clamp.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `clamp(value, min, max)` returning value limited to [min, max]. If min > max throw a RangeError.
acceptance_criteria: Export `clamp(value, min, max)` returning value limited to [min, max]. If min > max throw a RangeError.
